newsitem.title: CHINA: China province to send 2 mln tonnes corn to south.
newsitem.headline: China province to send 2 mln tonnes corn to south.

text.p: Chinese authorities have ordered northeastern Jilin province to send two million tonnes of corn to other regions to relieve shortages, the People's Daily said on Wednesday.
Trains laden with 27,000 tonnes of corn had already left the provincial capital, Changchun, while a ship carrying 10,000 tonnes had left Dalian in neighbouring Liaoning province, the newspaper said.
China's State Council, or cabinet, had ordered the shipments to relieve shortages elsewhere in China and to make sure local farmers still had an incentive to grow corn, the newspaper said.

The State Council and the State Grain Reserve Administration were working with grain officials across China to coordinate preferential financing and transportation to implement the programme, it said.
Jilin's corn output was 20 million tonnes in 1995, it said.
Beijing has maintained an official ban on corn exports since 1994 to try to curb rising prices but analysts have said poor transportation hampers corn movement within China.
